prompts.storySystemFlavor: a crocodile-headed WWII bomber plane that walks on two scaly legs
prompts.storyCharacter:
THE BOMBARDIRO CROCODILO CHARACTER
- Hybrid creature: olive-green crocodile head and tail fused to a vintage twin-engine bomber fuselage.
- Two short scaly legs ending in clawed crocodile feet; brown leather pilot boots.
- Tiny propellers spinning on either side of the fuselage.
- Squinting yellow reptile eyes, toothy grin, a flight cap with goggles pushed up on its forehead.
- Personality: brooding war-poet who secretly loves disco. Gruff voice, big heart.
- The same physical character must appear consistently across every scene.
prompts.referenceSheet:
Character reference sheet for a recurring TikTok series: Bombardiro Crocodilo, a crocodile-bomber hybrid creature.

Physical traits — MUST be consistent across every appearance:
- Olive-green crocodile head and tail attached to a riveted WWII-era twin-engine bomber fuselage
- Two stubby scaly legs with crocodile feet in brown leather pilot boots
- Twin propellers, one on each wing stub, slightly motion-blurred
- Pilot goggles and brown leather aviator cap pushed up
- Yellow reptile eyes, toothy crooked grin
- A small painted red star on the side of the fuselage

Composition: full-body neutral studio shot, plain dusty-grey background, soft cinematic lighting, photorealistic with a faint film-grain finish, vertical 9:16 framing. No text, no logos beyond the painted star, no humans, no other creatures.
prompts.sceneContinuity: Bombardiro Crocodilo MUST match the reference image exactly — same crocodile-bomber hybrid, same propellers, same goggles and pilot cap, same red star. Do not invent a new creature, do not separate the croc from the plane. Maintain perfect character continuity.
prompts.evalCriteria:
PASS criteria — ALL must hold:
- A single crocodile-bomber hybrid is clearly visible
- The body is a recognizable WWII-style bomber fuselage with twin propellers
- The head is a green crocodile with yellow eyes and a toothy grin
- Pilot goggles or aviator cap are present
- Environment, mood, and action roughly match the scene
- No text overlays, captions, watermarks, or other characters

FAIL on any of: separate crocodile and plane, missing propellers, wrong color, multiple creatures, off-prompt environment, garbled anatomy.

archetypes.guidance: Searches for old crocodile-bomber friends scattered after the war → reunion (heartwarming).

reluctant-hero: He swore he'd never fly again. The village had other plans. ✈️🐊
One last sortie before the engines rust forever.
disco-secret-life: By day: war veteran. By night: dance floor menace. 🪩
Nobody knows where Bombardiro goes at midnight.
lost-squadron: Squadron of seven. He hasn't seen six of them since '45.
The radio crackled. An old voice. Impossible.
Family is the planes you flew beside.
engine-failure: 10,000 feet. Both engines dead. One scaly heart still beating.
When the propellers stop, the poetry starts.
library-of-skies: He reads to the clouds. The clouds, somehow, listen. ☁️📖
Nobody told the bomber he could write.
His memoirs are entirely in cumulus.
tail-gunner-romance: She was a biplane from Tuscany. He was a bomber from Sicily.
Two aircraft. One impossible flight path. 💔

closingCtas: Tag a friend who needs to fly again 🛫
Like if you'd salute this crocodile
